concerns.text: The data artifacts produced by the pipeline (e.g., generation batch files) are described using field names such as `function_name` and `ast_params` (see Phase 2 – Generation and Phase 3 – Post‑process), but the contract `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` requires the fields `method_name` and `parameters`. This mismatch means the generated JSON will not validate against the declared schema, violating the contract‑plan consistency requirement.
